description: Displayed on the base; former registration F-THBB. The Mirage IIIB that stood at the base entrance was moved off base to the Pole Aeronautique d'Avord in August 2025. Mirage IV disposal list compiled by 'BEN' on the Delta Reflex forum (December 2023), which tracks all 62 Mirage IVA/IVP airframes individually.
